steps.text: who did I text the most in college?
Inferential 'who…most' question → the agent pre-fetches top-contact volume so the model has frequency data. 'college' is a life period → it reaches for get_message_volume_by_period.
This is a frequency question over a life period. Let me pull message volume by contact for my college years (~2014–2018).
Let me pull message volume by contact for my college years to be sure.
